Statement of Work — Acme Co. Website Redesign

PROJECT OVERVIEW
This SOW covers a full marketing-site redesign for Acme Co. Forge Creative
Agency will deliver visual design, front-end build, and content migration
from the existing WordPress instance.

Deliverables
- Discovery workshop and competitive audit
- Visual identity refresh (logo lockups, color palette, type system)
- High-fidelity Figma designs for 8 marketing pages
- Webflow build of the 8 pages, including responsive breakpoints
- Migration of existing blog posts into Webflow CMS
- CMS training session for Acme marketing team
- Two rounds of revisions per deliverable

Out of Scope
- Native mobile applications
- E-commerce or checkout functionality
- Backend API development
- Multi-language localization
- Custom illustration beyond the icon set defined in the visual identity

Timeline
Discovery and design phases run weeks 1-4. Build phase runs weeks 5-9.
QA and launch in week 10.

Acceptance Criteria
All deliverables reviewed by Acme stakeholder Pat M. Designs approved
in Figma; build approved on staging URL.

Fees
Total project fee: $48,000 split into three milestone payments.
